rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TEXmirlam
Exhibition name: Miranda Lambert ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Lawrence Valdez (United States, before 2012).
Introduced in United States by Texas Rose Ventures in 2016.
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2024 as 'Legend of Rossi'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong, fruity, rose fragrance. 38 to 43 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, well-branched. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 5 leaflets.

Height: 4'7" to 5'1" (140 to 155cm). Width: 33" to 43" (85 to 110cm).
